purpose: FULL behavioral constants (invariants) across the entire app that Codex must preserve. If changes are required, Codex must prove these still work via tests or explicit manual verification steps.

scope.note: These are behavior-level guarantees; implementation may change if invariants remain true.

non_negotiables: Do not rename Dash component IDs referenced below unless all callbacks, layouts, and tests are updated and verified.
All user-triggered write actions must result in correct success/failure feedback (alerts/toasts) without silent failures.
Quick-add flows must propagate newly created entities back into the originating form (default selection behavior).
No regression in critical save/delete flows: customer, booking, payment.
Pattern-matching IDs for export (type:export-btn/grid) must remain compatible with MATCH callbacks.

Table refresh containers must always update after successful CRUD: customers-table-container, bookings-table-container, payments-table-container, dresses-table-container, services-table-container, dept-table-container.
Search inputs must clear on successful add/delete operations (entity-specific).
All user-facing Arabic labels/messages must be valid UTF-8 (no mojibake artifacts like '???').
Role-gated screens must stay enforced: users management view/nav is available only for admin role.
Global shell must remain functional: url/page-content routing and app success toast must not regress.

invariants.title: Login must always show correct validation errors
verification: Manual: attempt login with empty fields -> warning appears
Manual: attempt login with wrong password -> danger appears
Manual: login success -> navigates to app and alert clears

invariants.title: Customer save must never be silent: show warning on missing required fields
verification: Manual: open customer modal and try to save with missing fields -> warning alert displayed and modal remains open

invariants.title: Customer add success must close modal, refresh table, and set last-added-customer
invariants.trigger: Successful add_customer() path from btn-save-customer when edit_id is empty

expected.last_added_customer_set: last-added-customer.data == new bride name (same value used by booking dropdown values)

verification: Manual: add a new customer; modal closes; customer appears in customer table; last-added-customer updated

invariants.title: Quick-add customer from Booking flow selects the new customer by default in booking form
invariants.context: Booking modal open while a customer is added via quick add
mechanism: Customers form sets last-added-customer.data on successful add
Bookings form listens to last-added-customer.data and updates b-customer options and value if modal-booking is open
verification: Manual: open booking modal; click quick add customer; save new customer; confirm booking's customer dropdown auto-selects the new bride name
Regression test recommended: simulate store update while modal-booking.is_open == True and assert b-customer.value == new name

Manual: attempt delete with no selection -> warning alert shows instruction

test_recommendations_for_codex.title: Add minimal callback-level regression tests (if project adopts dash testing)
notes: If not using dash testing, implement 'manual verification checklist' execution per release
At minimum: smoke_test + 3 manual scenarios: add customer quick-add selects in booking; booking save missing fields warns; booking delete shows correct alerts

test_recommendations_for_codex.title: Add scripted UI checks (Playwright) for invariants
notes: There is an e2e_playwright.py present; extend it with steps matching INV-BOOK-001/002/004

test_recommendations_for_codex.title: Add constitution lint check in CI
notes: Validate JSON schema and required keys (id/title/trigger/expected/verification)
Cross-check critical_component_ids against code with static scan
Fail CI on mojibake markers in app code or constitution text

requires_extra_proof: Any change touching the IDs listed in critical_component_ids
Any change touching last-added-customer store flow
Any change touching alert components or message rendering
proof_required: Updated tests OR updated manual verification checklist steps + evidence (logs/screenshots in PR)
